title: Steve's ATV Rentals
specs: Pismo Beach is the only place in California where you can drive an ATV on the beach
Pismo Beach offers over 3,500 acres of dunes and beach for riding
Oregon Dunes UTVs have long travel suspension to crawl obstacles
Pismo Beach beginner ATV for ages 9-12, 52-60 inches tall, under 130lbs
Step up ATV for riders over age 12 and over 140lbs
Sport machine recommended for riders over 14 or with experience
High performance ATV requires rider over 18 and demonstrated high performance riding ability
UTV operators must be minimum age 25 or 30 depending on model
Passengers must meet minimum height requirements (48" or 50" or 60" depending on vehicle)
Riders with suspended, revoked or expired licenses are not allowed to ride
